name: desktop
description: Cliente de escritorio de Opera (Electron + React + Vite + Tailwind)
author: Tomas Posada

scripts.build: node scripts/clean-resources.js && node scripts/fetch-docker-installer.js && pnpm --filter backend build && pnpm --filter backend deploy resources/backend --prod --config.node-linker=hoisted && node scripts/generate-backend-prisma.js && tsc && vite build && electron-builder --publish never
scripts.release: node scripts/clean-resources.js && node scripts/fetch-docker-installer.js && pnpm --filter backend build && pnpm --filter backend deploy resources/backend --prod --config.node-linker=hoisted && node scripts/generate-backend-prisma.js && tsc && vite build && electron-builder --publish always
